title: Draft the monthly investor update
goal: The update is drafted with the same metrics as last month, each citing its source, bad news first and at most three asks, and it is recorded sent only after the founder sends it.

steps.do: Stop here unless someone holds equity or a SAFE in the venture besides its founders, by the ownership record or the investor records.
Read last month's update and gather the same metrics, defined the same way, from their source records.
Draft the update with a headline, metrics, highlights, lowlights first when there is bad news, at most three asks and runway.
Raise a decision for the founder to approve and send it; record sent only after the founder sends it.

done_criteria.check: Does the update report the same metrics as last month, each citing its source, with no more than three specific asks?
